views.front: The can retains its genuine open body and perforated rose; the new short neck visibly connects the rose to the original spout.
views.rear: The carrying and rear handles now have smooth rounded joints while retaining their original angular handle layout and attachments.
views.detail: Full-size inspection confirms the open rim, smooth handle sections and connected long spout. The metal grain remains stylized at close zoom.
views.underside: The closed can base and rose connection read continuously from below; the original perforation pattern remains intact.
views.clay: The neutral silhouette remains an immediately recognizable long-spout watering can with improved handle bends and no detached head.
